result: S. pombe lacks a Hac1/XBP1 ortholog and UPR-dependent transcriptional program. Instead, Ire1 maintains ER homeostasis through post-transcriptional mechanisms: RIDD of ER-targeted mRNAs and Bip1 mRNA processing. RNA-seq analysis revealed 39 mRNAs reduced >2-fold in an Ire1- and DTT-dependent manner, all encoding ER-targeted proteins, with enrichment for secretory pathway functions.

result: Ire1 initiates RIDD in S. pombe through sequence-dependent cleavage at a UG\C consensus motif. Cleavage products accumulate in Ski2Δ cells and carry 2',3'-cyclic phosphates. The Gas2 ORF is sufficient for Ire1-dependent cleavage, and mutation of the UGC motif abolishes cleavage at that site. An Ire1 RNase mutant cannot sustain growth under ER stress.

result: Bip1 mRNA is uniquely processed by Ire1 cleavage at G373 in the 3' UTR, resulting in loss of polyA tail and increased stability. The truncated mRNA (tBip1) is more stable than full-length, and this processing is Ire1-dependent and sequence-specific. Bip1 is the only mRNA in S. pombe that loses its polyA tail upon UPR induction while remaining stable.
